body:
Good morning, my friend!

Have you met Mr. Amos? He is the carpenter, and his workshop is by the village square. He makes doors and tables and toys, and he's always glad of a helper.

Why don't you go and say hello? He says his offcut box needs sorting!
summary: Meet Mr. Amos the carpenter, and sort the shapes in his workshop.
done: You met Mr. Amos and sorted his shapes!
